stem:
The graph of linear function g passes through the points (-7, -4) and (7, 6), as shown.

What are the slope and y-intercept of the graph of g?

options.label: A
options.text: The slope is \( \frac{5}{7} \), and the y-intercept is -1.

options.label: B
options.text: The slope is \( \frac{5}{7} \), and the y-intercept is 1.

options.label: C
options.text: The slope is \( \frac{7}{5} \), and the y-intercept is -1.

options.label: D
options.text: The slope is \( \frac{7}{5} \), and the y-intercept is 1.
